speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: With the push towards better living standards in our dormitories, including stricter regulatory requirements, how does the Ministry strike a balance between safeguarding workers' welfare and avoiding excessive compliance costs for businesses?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: What efforts are in place to ensure that the regulatory upgrades are implemented in a cost effective and phased manner?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: At the same time, we are also injecting new supply, as I said in my main reply.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Together, this will ensure adequate supply, even as we require dormitories to transition to newer standards.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: With that, I think we can transit to the desired dormitory standards over time, without impacting too much of dormitory supply.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: In fact, that has been the case over the past year.
